We're investing in the next stage of that relationship: growth. Our clients don't run one event — they run portfolios, sometimes more than a hundred events, each with its own calendar, its own team and its own decision points. Growing alongside them at that scale is a discipline in its own right: a repeatable motion, a shared qualification standard, and a rhythm built around the client's event cycle rather than our fiscal quarters.
The CAM team sits inside our Customer organisation, alongside Solution Design, Implementation and Support. Whoever leads it works shoulder to shoulder with the teams that scope, deliver and support everything the CAMs sell.
Today, two team leads run the CAM function reporting directly into leadership. Scope: Portfolio. 500+ events across our installed base, run by organisers whose portfolios range from a handful of events to well over a hundred.
 Team. 10+ people spread between the US and Europe. Two CAM leads report to you directly who run the rest of the team.
 Target. +20% growth on the installed base, delivered through an account-based strategy.
 Two levers. Higher penetration of each client's event portfolio, and upsell of digital add-ons and additional modules on the events already running on Swapcard.
 Mandate. Renew, expand, and prevent churn and downsell.
